description: Provenance for research/e8-rank9-extra-zeros. checks/ = own code. e8lib.py, modrank.py, a2e8.py, spans.py, spans3.py, pframes.py, manifest_check.py are copied from research/e8-rank9-realisations (#2819); blib.py is a compatibility shim over e8lib.py (same line order, so CNF regeneration is byte-identical to the working cards' files); the other scripts are the working cards' scripts (cliquespans, bridge with an exact entrywise root-realisation test, rkz, pcompK, pcompK2, pinz, pinz2, s56z, spansminus, rigA2, lemex, fchoice, hit) with absolute paths removed. evidence/*_THEORY_snapshot.md = exported card texts (copies; absolute paths and working-time log lines removed; sections about unsuccessful probes removed). evidence/proofs/*.drat.xz = kissat 4.0.4 DRAT proofs. External: philippeVV/integer-mult-bounds @ 93766d7d (decoder-law/lift-family, lift-family-2; Discussion #1587 follow-ups 7, 8 and 9; also @ b5ce9d22 closures-3/decoder-law-subsets for Theorem R3), read for definitions only, not vendored. Tools (not vendored): kissat 4.0.4, drat-trim.
